repos_data.description: Open source device layer for AI coding agents: a CLI, MCP server, and typed Node.js API to control mobile, web, TV, and desktop apps on devices and simulators, locally or in the cloud.
Self-hosted iOS & Android simulator streaming for the whole team

Run Android apps on your Mac like Mac apps: each in its own window with its own Dock icon, on Apple silicon. Notifications, game controllers, privacy controls. Free & open source (LineageOS + QEMU + scrcpy).

Free ADB GUI and Android Emulator control panel for macOS. One click for dark mode, font scale, RTL and pseudo-locales, TalkBack, layout bounds, network speed and GPS: no adb commands. Layout Inspector in dp for any app (Compose and Views) with Figma overlay and TalkBack-order audit. Plus an MCP server for AI agents.

MCP server for Android — drive emulators and real devices over adb from Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code. 73 tools: screenshots, UI hierarchy, tap/swipe/type, logcat, device locks, Gradle builds and tests. The Android counterpart to XcodeBuildMCP.
